overview:
The **First Battle of Ruusan** (1010 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **New Sith Wars**, fought on or above **Ruusan**. Opening clash of the ruusan campaign with jedi army of light skirmishing brotherhood of darkness sith infantry across misty ruusan valleys.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the New Sith Wars in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the First Battle of Ruusan within the broader **New Sith Wars** campaign. Front-line reports describe opening clash of the ruusan campaign with jedi army of light skirmishing brotherhood of darkness sith infantry across misty ruusan valleys.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **1010 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the New Sith Wars.
significance: The First Battle of Ruusan illustrates how the New Sith Wars reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
